mapper.sql: id, comment_object_id, comment_type, content, images, comment_user_id, sort, reply_count, like_count, audit_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.insert: insert into component_comment (id, comment_object_id, comment_type, content, images, comment_user_id, sort, reply_count, like_count, audit_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{id}, #{commentObjectId}, #{commentType}, #{content}, #{images}, #{commentUserId}, #{sort}, #{replyCount}, #{likeCount}, #{auditStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select from component_comment where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update component_comment set content = #{content}, images = #{images}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and comment_object_id = #{commentObjectId} and is_delete = 0
